brief_summary: Three-row horizontal bar comparison of total switch travel: Cherry MX2A Red at 4.0mm (warm-grey, longest bar), Akko V3 Cream Blue Pro at 3.3mm (coral), and Gazzew Boba U4T at 3.2mm (coral). Shows that two differently-designed shortened-travel tactiles land close together well under the MX-style 4.0mm default, independent of their spring weights.
data_sources: shortened-travel-switches-deep-dive.mdx § 'The 4.0mm default, and what gets cut' — 'Two switches, two different vendors, two different ways of getting there, both landing in the same shortened-travel territory below 3.5mm.'
